Leo is going to travel to Chengdu in March. There are always many people at the health check. Leo spent the weekend at the park. Heavy rain caused flooding, and the resulting damage was serious.
Lily is interested in swimming. Lily's birthday is in March. Life is full of small surprises. In addition, the ticket includes lunch.
They took many photos at the health check. Leo hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Leo and Lily had great fun there. Also, don't push; there are enough seats for everyone.
The weather was rainy that day. Last Sunday, Leo and Lily went to the park path. It takes twenty minutes to get to the park path by bike.
